GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 311.2 (18 Jan 49) CCS
(SCAPIN - 1985)
APO 500
14 March 1949
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Suspension of Operation. Tokyo-Moscow Radiotelegraph Circuit.
1. The Japanese Government is directed to suspend operation of the Tokyo-Moscow radiotelegraph circuit effective 0001 hours 16 March 1949.
2. Due to administrative difficulties no messages of any classification will be received or transmitted over the subject circuit, after the suspension date, unless otherwise directed by the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
3. Messages between Japan and the USSR may continue to circulate over all other radiotelegraph or cable routes authorized by the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
4. Direct communication between the Civil Communications Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, and the Ministry of Communications, regarding matters within the scope of this memorandum, is authorized.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
